name: UNSEEN
source:
As Alex Chen, building a new life at the university entails bonding with your hardy roommate Jordan, flirting with the mysterious barista Riley, and attending the questionable support group set up by Dr. Marsh. But when an hour-'til-midnight revelation in the library corners the room with a sense of nefarious conspiracy, you will require gall to outrun the truth, and perhaps some vulnerability to allow others in.  

[From [url=https://xei-games.itch.io/unseen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为亚历克斯·陈，在大学建立新生活需要与你坚强的室友乔丹建立联系，与神秘的咖啡师莱利调情，并参加马什博士建立的可疑的支持小组。但是，当图书馆里直到午夜的一个小时的揭露让房间里充满了邪恶的阴谋感时，你将需要勇气来逃避真相，也许还需要一些脆弱性来允许其他人进入。

[来自[url=https://xei-games.itch.io/unseen]itch.io[/url]]
